_readme: OpenLIME LayerNeuralRTI config template (what initialize() reads).
Not the training info.json: export weights/biases from the .pt/.ckpt into this shape.
Sibling image planes must be named plane_1.jpg, plane_2.jpg, plane_3.jpg (layout: image).
ChristInPity/nrti currently has plane_0..2 — rename or symlink to plane_1..3.
Classic architecture in ShaderNeural comments: samples≈49, planes=9 → n=52, c=12 after %4 pad.

_from_christ_in_pity_nrti.map_minimum_maximum: training info.json uses minimum/maximum — copy into min/max (same nesting or flat-then-reshape to 3×3)
_from_christ_in_pity_nrti.features_9: matches planes=9 if three RGB coefficient JPEGs
_from_christ_in_pity_nrti.model_state_pt_best_ckpt: source of weights/biases — not read by OpenLIME; convert offline into weights[]/biases[]
_from_christ_in_pity_nrti.coefficient_npy: not used by LayerNeuralRTI (web path uses plane_*.jpg only)
